invariants: Each physical entity has exactly one current location and one attachment state
Child entities name existing parents and causal creation records; reuse does not mint a new specimen
Repair, sensor movement, guide remounting and target modification increment relevant configuration/version and invalidate stale receipts
Four distinct sensors bind four ports and four pressure channels; a single serial cannot stand in for multiple ports
Guide reuse across branches is episode-declared and conditioned on integrity and valid calibration; source historical sample count remains unknown
Single-edge and half-aperture uses cannot be assumed to involve the same plate unless allocation declares it
Raw and failed records are append-only; a retry gets a distinct attempt ID with supersession links
Physical points, interpolated pixels, technical repeats, numerical modes and independent samples are different counts
Derived records reference exact raw parents, processing version and data class; literature outcomes cannot become raw observations
No damaged or quarantined target/guide re-enters acquisition without repair/version/QC closure
A supplied target does not require an invented historic fabrication job; record known supplier/prior preparation provenance and unresolved history honestly
